page.overview:
What is Apple?

Apples are food items that can be eaten by the player.

Oak and dark oak leaves have 0.5% () chance of dropping an apple when decayed or broken, but not if burned. Breaking leaves with a tool enchanted with the Fortune enchantment increases the chances of dropping an apple: 0.556% () with Fortune I, 0.625% () with Fortune II, and 0.833% () with Fortune III.

Apprentice-level farmer villagers have a 50% () or 66.7% () chance of selling 4 apples as part of their trades.

To eat an apple, press and hold while it is selected in the hotbar. Eating one restores hunger and 2.4 saturation.
